reasons.fact: AuditSnapshots keeps a bounded detached event batch during its existing asynchronous settings read, so startup and expired snapshots no longer discard the triggering event when that read returns enabled settings. The read result makes the initial admission decision; pending events bind once to its revision, after the Collector observes that revision. Disabled, absent, invalid, failed, timed-out or closed loads discard pending payload permanently. Concurrent Enable before the read observes settings can authorize in-flight content; no event-time enabled guarantee or later revival of discarded content is claimed. Product responses remain synchronous and nonblocking. Metadata reservations still survive until physical store settlement. Collector admission limits and fresh exact-revision authorization remain. No new component, dependency, datastore, durable queue or deployment is added. The customer capture guarantee changes within the existing audit-logs owner; current plan, reference contract and registry prose are updated; registry Mermaid views remain unchanged.
